entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The largest supercontinent on Dominaria, setting of Mirage, Visions and Prophecy.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Jamuraa lies.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A strong religious state in northwest Jamuraa with capital Tulumai.

entities.name: Suq'Ata Empire
entities.description: A powerful merchant nation and trading province of Jamuraa.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A militaristic kingdom that was phased out by Teferi and later became its own plane.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: A powerful, evil mage who tried to conquer western Jamuraa and was defeated.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Leader of the Jamuraan city-states who opposed Johan with the Robaran Mercenaries.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: A wizard who created Mangara's Harmony, a peace agreement between Jamuraa's nations.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: An evil wizard against whom Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata united.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: A jungle-dwelling sorceress deceived into aiding Kaervek.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased Zhalfir out after the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Sealed the rift before Zhalfir could be phased back in, erasing it from Dominaria.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: During his exile he poisoned tribes of Gulatto Meisha and started a rebellion among the Oryn Deeps dwarves.

entities.name: Afari
entities.description: Author of the Tales of Jamuraa.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenaries who fought Johan alongside Hazezon Tamar.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: The war in which Johan attempted to conquer western Jamuraa.

entities.name: Mirage Wars
entities.description: The war against Kaervek during which Jamuraa was plundered.

entities.name: Mangara's Harmony
entities.description: The peace agreement that brought a new age of enlightenment to Jamuraa.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Invaders who attacked Jamuraa during the Prophecy War.

entities.name: Zhalfirin Void
entities.description: The void left where Zhalfir was phased out.

events.summary: Johan, tyrant of Tirras, tries to conquer western Jamuraa and clashes with the city-states led by Hazezon Tamar.
events.quote: was a powerful but evil mage who tried to conquer the Jamuraan western continent

events.summary: Johan's attempt to enslave the cat warrior tribes of the Sukurvian Desert leads them to ally with humans and defeat him.
events.quote: which would lead them to ally with the humans to ultimately defeat Johan

events.summary: Mangara creates a peace agreement between Jamuraa's rival nations and a buffer zone policed by Quirion elves.
events.quote: Within a century Mangara's Harmony created a new age of enlightenment.

events.summary: After Mangara vanishes, Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata unite against Kaervek, who is first aided by the deceived Jolrael.
events.quote: Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq-Ata united against the evil wizard Kaervek after the vanishing of Mangara.

events.summary: Jamuraa suffers a Keldon invasion during the Prophecy War, just before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.
events.quote: Jamuraa was subject to a Keldon invasion right before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: After the Phyrexian war, Teferi phases out Zhalfir to save it from further strife.
events.quote: the planeswalker Teferi decided to save thew region of Zhalfir from further strife, and phased it out

events.summary: Jeska seals the time rift before Zhalfir can be phased back in, effectively erasing it from Dominaria.
events.quote: Jeska Planeswalker sealed the rift before Zhalfir could be phased back in

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Zhalfir becomes its own plane, leaving Jamuraa without its former glory.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Zhalfir would become its own plane
